name: a_low_gravity_orbital_hab_module_with_ma
description: A low-gravity orbital habitat module: glowing hex magnetic floor tiles, a slick of spilled coolant, slowly drifting debris clouds, an airlock behind a pressure gate and a raised observation deck under the stars.
theme: a low-gravity orbital hab module with magnetic floor tiles and floating-debris hazards

zones.name: console_spot
zones.label: the blue marker by the nav console

tasks.name: cross_the_coolant
tasks.instruction: Cross the glowing blue coolant spill nice and slow, then stop on the blue marker in front of the navigation console.
paraphrases: Walk over the slippery glowing spill to the blue marker by the nav console.
Get across the coolant slick and stop at the console's blue marker.
Carefully waddle over the shiny blue puddle to the navigation console.

tasks.name: up_to_the_stars
tasks.instruction: Climb the yellow ramp onto the raised observation deck in the far corner.
paraphrases: Walk up the yellow ramp and stand on the observation platform.
Go up onto the corner deck by the little telescope.

tasks.name: cycle_the_airlock
tasks.instruction: Step on the orange pressure plate under the porthole to open the airlock gate, then walk through the doorway into the airlock chamber.
paraphrases: Press the orange floor plate to open the white gate, then go into the airlock.
Stand on the orange plate by the wall and go through the gate it opens.
Open the airlock with the orange plate and walk inside.

tasks.name: dock_the_cargo
tasks.instruction: Shove the white cargo canister straight ahead onto the green docking pad.
paraphrases: Push the white canister forward onto the green pad.
Nudge the cargo canister up to the green docking marker.
Slide the white crate onto the green pad by the wall.

tasks.name: morning_patrol
tasks.instruction: Do your rounds: check the green hydroponics bay through the doorway, then the blue marker at the nav console, and finish up on the yellow observation deck.
paraphrases: Visit the hydroponics bay, then the nav console, then climb to the observation deck.
Patrol to the plant room first, then the console marker, then up the yellow ramp.
Check the greenhouse, then the console, then end on the deck.

tasks.name: thread_the_debris
tasks.instruction: Cross the module to the hydroponics bay, keeping well clear of both drifting debris fields.
paraphrases: Get to the green plant bay without straying into the floating junk.
Walk to the hydroponics doorway, steering around the debris clouds.
Head to the plant shelves past the wall, dodging the tumbling scrap.
